title: 線上學習
description: 線上課程與遠端學習用語

sentences.en: The online class starts at 9 AM.
sentences.zh: 線上課程早上九點開始。

sentences.en: Please mute your microphone when you're not speaking.
sentences.zh: 不說話時請把麥克風靜音。

sentences.en: Can you share your screen?
sentences.zh: 你能分享你的螢幕嗎？

sentences.en: I'll join the video call in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我馬上加入視訊通話。

sentences.en: The assignment is due by midnight.
sentences.zh: 作業在午夜前截止。

sentences.en: Which platform are we using for class?
sentences.zh: 我們上課用哪個平台？

sentences.en: My internet connection is unstable.
sentences.zh: 我的網路連線不穩定。

sentences.en: Can you see my screen?
sentences.zh: 你們看得到我的螢幕嗎？

sentences.en: I can't hear you. Can you check your microphone?
sentences.zh: 我聽不到你，你能檢查一下麥克風嗎？

sentences.en: The lecture was recorded for later viewing.
sentences.zh: 這堂課有錄影可以之後看。

sentences.en: Please turn on your camera.
sentences.zh: 請打開你的攝影機。

sentences.en: I submitted my homework through the online portal.
sentences.zh: 我透過線上平台交了作業。

sentences.en: The teacher posted new materials on the website.
sentences.zh: 老師在網站上發布了新教材。

sentences.en: Let's use the chat function to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 讓我們用聊天功能來提問。

sentences.en: I'm having trouble logging in.
sentences.zh: 我登入有問題。

sentences.en: The breakout room discussion starts now.
sentences.zh: 分組討論室現在開始。

sentences.en: Can everyone see the presentation?
sentences.zh: 大家都看得到簡報嗎？

sentences.en: Please download the file before class.
sentences.zh: 請在上課前下載檔案。

sentences.en: I'll upload the notes to the shared folder.
sentences.zh: 我會把筆記上傳到共享資料夾。

sentences.en: The Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting.
sentences.zh: Wi-Fi 一直斷線。

sentences.en: You're on mute. We can't hear you.
sentences.zh: 你在靜音，我們聽不到你。

sentences.en: Let me check if the link works.
sentences.zh: 讓我確認一下連結能不能用。

sentences.en: The online forum is a great place to discuss.
sentences.zh: 線上論壇是很好的討論場所。

sentences.en: I watched the pre-recorded lecture yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天看了預錄的課程。

sentences.en: Please submit your work as a PDF file.
sentences.zh: 請以PDF檔案格式繳交作業。

sentences.en: The teacher will send the meeting link by email.
sentences.zh: 老師會用電子郵件寄會議連結。

sentences.en: I prefer learning at my own pace online.
sentences.zh: 我比較喜歡線上按自己的進度學習。

sentences.en: Don't forget to check the announcements page.
sentences.zh: 別忘了查看公告頁面。

sentences.en: There's a discussion board for each module.
sentences.zh: 每個單元都有討論區。

sentences.en: The deadline for enrollment is next Monday.
sentences.zh: 註冊截止日期是下週一。
